title: Joe Budden Violates Claudia Jordan & Vivica A. Fox [Listen]
htmlContent:
Joe Budden responded to criticism from Vivica A. Fox about his comments about Megan Thee Stallion.

While speaking in the last episode of her podcast, Budden had a few words of choice for the host of Cocktails With Queens and his co-host Claudia Jordan. In the same episode heard him apologize to Megan Thee Stallion for the comments.

“Claudia Jordan, shut the fuck up. You got to shut the fuck up. It could get bad,” Budden said, before directing his energy at Fox.

“Once regarded as the Black woman that all of America wanted to be with just so we’re clear on that,” the Joe Budden Podcast host said. “Long fall from grace. You bitches don’t know how to usefully use your pussy broth is the problem. So now, be very careful with how you continue to speak about me because I got right here Vivica Fox movies.

“Vivica Fox, shut the fuck up before I book you for a movie,” he continued. “You don’t cost but $5 to get it done. I will book that entire Fox old hoes show for $75.99. You bitches better leave me alone.”

H/T Hip Hop DX for the transcription.

In which it Vivica A. Fox would chimed in and responded, “Joe Budden if you don’t button it up and sit your bitch ass down hating on that girl,” Fox said. “You all mad ’cause girls is ruling rap. It’s just driving you all crazy that the sistas is just ruling over and taking numbers and can tell you about yourselves, look sexy with it, it’s a new day.”

 She added, “But if you wanted some attention, to be honest with you, I think that’s the wrong one to try to get it from because it’s really coming out facts it’s coming out after so many years of this trial being long-awaited that she was shot. So, you know, get used to it, brother, it’s a new day. Girls are ruling, sorry Joe Budden.”
